Title: GoPlus
Description: Onchain security scanner for tokens, wallets and dApps.
Full description: GoPlus Security provides real-time risk analysis for tokens, smart contracts and wallet interactions. It helps users detect honeypots, malicious contracts, risky permissions and scam behaviors before signing transactions.
Cos'è:
GoPlus Security is an on-chain risk analysis tool that evaluates the safety of tokens, smart contracts and DeFi interactions.


It is used to:

  • Check if a token may be a scam

  • Detect honeypot behavior

  • Analyze smart contract risks

  • Evaluate wallet and dApp security

It is one of the most widely used backend security systems integrated by wallets and DeFi platforms.
Come funziona:
GoPlus analyzes:

  • Contract address

  • Token parameters

  • Owner permissions

  • Mint functions

  • Tax settings

  • Blacklist / whitelist logic

Typical workflow:

  1. Connect wallet to goplus

  2. The system scans the wallet and smart contract

  3. A risk report is generated

  4. Potential red flags are highlighted

Many wallets integrate GoPlus automatically to display warnings before you sign a transaction.
quando usarlo:
Use GoPlus when:

  • You are about to buy a new token

  • You interact with unknown smart contracts

  • You farm airdrops

  • You discover newly launched DEX tokens

  • You want to avoid honeypots

Title: Token Sniffer
Description: Automatic scanner to detect honeypots and rug pulls
Full description: An automated token security scanner that analyzes smart contracts for honeypot patterns, rug pull mechanisms, ownership concentration, and other red flags before you buy.
Cos'è:
Token Sniffer is a free tool that scans a token's smart contract and gives you a security score before you invest a single dollar.

Think of it as a metal detector at the airport: it won't catch everything, but it will flag the most obvious threats. If a token fails Token Sniffer's checks, walk away. If it passes, that's a green light to dig deeper — not a guarantee of safety.
Come funziona:
1. Go to tokensniffer.com and paste the token contract address.

  2. The tool automatically analyzes the contract code for known scam patterns.

  3. You receive a score and a breakdown of checks: honeypot test, ownership renouncement, liquidity lock, similar contracts, and more.

  4. Red flags are highlighted clearly — failed checks mean high risk.

Supports Ethereum, BSC, Base, Avalanche, and more chains. Free to use, no wallet connection required.
quando usarlo:
• Every single time you're about to buy a new or unknown token.

  • When someone sends you a contract address on Telegram or Twitter.

  • Before aping into a meme coin or presale token.

  • As a first-pass filter before doing deeper manual research.

Make it a habit: if you don't check Token Sniffer first, you're flying blind.

Title: Revoke.cash
Description: Revoke token approvals from your wallet.
Full description: Revoke.cash allows users to view and revoke smart contract token approvals granted by their wallet. It helps reduce the risk of wallet drain attacks by removing unnecessary permissions.
Cos'è:
Revoke.cash is a security tool that allows users to manage and remove token approvals from their wallet.

When you interact with DeFi protocols, you often grant unlimited token allowances to smart contracts. If those contracts are compromised, your funds may be at risk.


Revoke.cash helps you:

  • View all active token approvals

  • Identify unlimited allowances

  • Revoke unnecessary permissions

  • Reduce attack surface

It is widely recommended for active DeFi and airdrop users.
Come funziona:
Revoke.cash scans your wallet address and displays:

  • Approved tokens

  • Spender contract addresses

  • Approval amount (limited or unlimited)

  • Network used

Typical workflow:

  1. Connect your wallet

  2. Select blockchain network

  3. View all active approvals

  4. Click “Revoke” on unwanted permissions

  5. Confirm transaction in wallet

Important:

Revoking requires a blockchain transaction → gas fees apply.
quando usarlo:
Use Revoke.cash when:

  • You used many DeFi protocols

  • You farmed airdrops

  • You interacted with unknown dApps

  • You suspect wallet risk

  • You want routine wallet hygiene

Best practice:

Check approvals every 1–2 months if you are an active DeFi user.

Title: Honeypot.is
Description: Dedicated honeypot checker for tokens on ETH, BSC
Full description: A specialized tool that simulates buy and sell transactions for any token to detect honeypots — contracts that allow buying but block selling — before you commit real funds.
Cos'è:
Honeypot.is does one thing and does it well: it tells you if you can actually sell a token after buying it.

A honeypot is a trap: the contract lets you buy freely, but when you try to sell, the transaction fails or gets blocked. You're stuck holding a worthless token with no exit. Honeypot.is simulates the sell before you buy — like test-driving a car in reverse before paying for it.
Come funziona:
1. Go to honeypot.is and paste the token contract address.

  2. Select the chain (ETH, BSC, etc.).

  3. The tool simulates a buy and sell transaction without using real funds.

  4. Results show: is it a honeypot? What are the buy/sell taxes? Is there a max transaction limit?

Takes less than 10 seconds. No wallet connection required. Free forever.
quando usarlo:
• Before buying any token you found on DEX or in a Telegram group.

  • When buy/sell taxes seem unusually high or asymmetric.

  • When a token is new and has no audit or reputation yet.

  • Use it alongside Token Sniffer for a double layer of basic security checks.

This is the minimum viable security check before any DEX purchase. No excuses.

Title: Brave Browser
Description: Open-source, privacy-first browser with built-in ad blocking and a native crypto wallet.
Full description: Brave is a free, open-source web browser built on Chromium and launched in 2016 by Brendan Eich, co-founder of Mozilla and creator of JavaScript. It blocks ads, trackers and fingerprinting by default through Brave Shields, with no extra extensions needed, and includes a private browsing mode with Tor for extra anonymity. Brave ships with a built-in, non-custodial crypto wallet supporting multiple blockchains (Ethereum, Solana and others), plus optional Brave Rewards, which pays users in BAT tokens for viewing privacy-respecting ads. Available on desktop and mobile.
Cos'è: Brave is a free, open-source web browser built on Chromium, created in 2016 by Brendan Eich (co-founder of Mozilla, creator of JavaScript). It's built around privacy: blocking ads and trackers by default, rather than relying on separate extensions.
Come funziona:
• Brave Shields blocks third-party ads, trackers and browser fingerprinting automatically, with per-site controls to adjust or disable them.

  • A private browsing window with Tor routes traffic through the Tor network for extra anonymity.

  • A built-in, non-custodial crypto wallet connects to multiple blockchains (Ethereum, Solana and others) directly from the browser, no separate extension required.

  • Brave Rewards is optional: users can choose to view privacy-respecting ads in exchange for BAT tokens.
quando usarlo: Useful as a daily browser for anyone wanting built-in ad and tracker blocking without installing extra extensions, or for accessing a non-custodial multi-chain wallet directly in the browser.

Title: Pocket Universe
Description: Transaction simulator that shows before you sign
Full description: A browser extension that simulates every transaction before you sign it, showing exactly what assets will leave and enter your wallet, and flagging phishing sites and malicious contract interactions in real time.
Cos'è:
Pocket Universe is a browser extension that acts as your last line of defense before signing any on-chain transaction.

Before you confirm in MetaMask or any other wallet, Pocket Universe simulates what will actually happen: what leaves your wallet, what comes in, and whether anything looks suspicious. It's like having a financial advisor read the contract before you sign — in real time, in under a second.
Come funziona:
1. Install the Pocket Universe browser extension (Chrome/Firefox).

  2. When you initiate any transaction, Pocket Universe intercepts it before the wallet popup appears.

  3. It simulates the transaction and shows a clear summary: assets leaving, assets entering, approvals being granted.

  4. If it detects a phishing site or malicious contract, it shows a warning before you can confirm.

  5. You decide whether to proceed or cancel — you always have full control.
quando usarlo:
• Always install it once and it protects every transaction automatically.

  • Especially when interacting with new or unfamiliar DeFi protocols.

  • When minting NFTs from links shared on social media.

  • When you receive DMs with airdrop or claim links.

One of the highest ROI security tools available: free, passive, and catches mistakes before they happen.

Title: Ian Coleman
Description: Mnemonic generator and address derivation tool.
Full description: A client-side tool for generating BIP39 mnemonic seed phrases and deriving private keys, public keys and addresses across hundreds of coins. Supports custom entropy sources, multiple derivation standards (BIP32/44/49/84) and fully offline use.
Cos'è: Ian Coleman's BIP39 tool is an open-source mnemonic code converter used to generate and recover BIP39 seed phrases and derive the corresponding wallet keys.
Come funziona:
- Generate a new random seed phrase (12 to 24 words) 

- Recover addresses and private keys from an existing mnemonic 

- Derive keys following BIP32, BIP44, BIP49 or BIP84 paths 

- Test or verify wallet recovery before relying on it


Typical workflow: 

1. Generate a random mnemonic using the browser's cryptographic randomness, or supply your own entropy (dice, coin flips, cards) 

2. Select the coin and derivation standard 

3. The tool derives the seed, root key, and a list of addresses with their private/public keys 

4. Results can be reviewed in a table and columns toggled to isolate specific data  


The developer recommends downloading the standalone HTML file and running it on an offline, air-gapped device rather than using the live website when handling a real seed.
quando usarlo:
Use this tool when: 

- Setting up a new wallet and wanting to understand what a seed phrase actually derives 

- Recovering addresses and keys from an existing mnemonic 

- Verifying that a wallet's recovery phrase produces the expected addresses 

- Learning how HD wallet derivation (BIP32/44/49/84) works  


Important: never enter a real seed phrase into this tool while online, and never share the resulting output with anyone, legitimate support will never ask for it.
